directive: **Automations** — propose cron automations and arm each with `bsc plan automations add <name> --command <cmd> [--schedule <cron>]`.
name: Automations
blurb: Cron rules that load context or dispatch commands.
prompt:
Propose cron-triggered rules that load a knowledge block or dispatch a command
into a console pane. Arm each with `bsc plan automations add <name> --command <cmd>
[--schedule <cron>] [--description <text>]` — omit --schedule for on-demand. You can
also keep recipe notes in automations.md, but the gate reads the armed automations.

Gate: at least one automation is armed.
